name: Crash Or Pass
author: Addicting Games
description: Crash Or Pass is a free racing game. You're trapped on an infinite loop in this fun, free racing game. you cannot stop or start. All you can do is slow your car down or speed it up at the appropriate time in an effort to avoid the other clueless drivers on the road. Remember, this is a game about reflexes and speed. You've got to know when to speed up, when to hit the brakes when to slow it down, and when to pass. The one thing you don't want to do is crash. In this game, the only thing you can really screw up is crashing, and once you crash, that is it. It is literally game over. This is an endless game where the longer you stay alive and the more levels you play the bigger your score is, so pass. Don't crash.
